close_reason: Implemented in commit 8d8b6c5. metadata_set now takes if_in_state: Option<&State> as the 4th positional arg, mirroring canonical email_set. Wire injection conditional on Some via args['ifInState']. Wiremock test metadata_set_passes_if_in_state asserts the wire field is 's10' when caller passes Some(State::from('s10')).
description: metadata_set in src/methods/metadata.rs:130 omits the ifInState argument. RFC 8620 §5.3 defines ifInState as a standard /set arg, and the metadata-server handler at crate-jmap-metadata-server/src/metadata.rs:319 reads and enforces it. Without it, clients cannot do optimistic-concurrency-guarded Metadata/set, which is the standard way to detect 'someone else mutated the account state between my get and my set' — a common need given the (relatedType, relatedId, @type, isPrivate) uniqueness invariant. The canonical sibling email_set (mail-client/src/methods/email.rs:104) takes if_in_state: Option<&State>; metadata_set is divergent. Note: chat-client and calendars-client extension siblings also omit ifInState on their _set methods, so this is workspace-wide divergence from the canonical mail-client template — fix needs to propagate. Trigger: client wants to do read-modify-write on Metadata; without ifInState the write may race against a concurrent peer. Fix: add 4th param 'if_in_state: Option<&State>' and conditionally inject "ifInState": s into args before create/update/destroy. Mirror email_set wire shape.
title: metadata_set: missing ifInState arg
